action_items.action: Help 5th grader sell cookie dough — goal of 10 tubs per student to fund science camp
Return order forms and money (checks to Lincoln Elementary 5th Grade Fund)

telegram_summary: 🍪 FUNDRAISER: 5th grade cookie dough fundraiser now thru Oct 15. $16/tub, goal of 10 tubs per student. Proceeds fund promotion ceremony & science camp. Order forms + money due Oct 15.
why_it_matters: This fundraiser directly funds your 5th grader's end-of-year activities including science camp. Participating helps ensure these activities are fully funded.
